homes: Production RTS pixel-art transparent sprite sheet for a distant dark fantasy atlas. Exactly 3 columns by 5 rows, wide transparent gutters. Every cell contains ONLY a separate tiny building or group of 2 tiny buildings, no terrain whatsoever: NO ground, NO grass, NO trees, NO rock mound, NO streets, NO courtyard base, NO pedestal. Actual transparent alpha between every building, right down to foundations. Bird's-eye orthographic oblique view 65 degrees down, upper-left light, soft charcoal shadows directly under walls only, muted old stone wood and slate, restrained painted pixel clusters, compatible with old fantasy map relief. No text, no labels, no people, no giant castle. Small low buildings, broad roof visible, subtle material variation. All pieces fully contained with generous empty gutters. Five rows top to bottom: plains (ochre thatch and weathered limestone); forest (dark timber moss slate roofs); islands (pale stone grey blue roofs, NO boats or docks); swamp (plum grey wood roofs on SHORT stilts, no water); mountains (dusty rose stone and rust grey slate). Three columns left to right: one modest cottage; two adjacent cottages with a narrow transparent gap; small civic hall with one tiny old gold pennant. Buildings only.
